content.text:
Excellent! All 68 tests pass. I've created:

**`src/render.js`** with **`renderInvoiceText(invoice)`**:
- Returns a plain-text invoice formatted as:
  1. First line: invoice number (e.g., `INV-2024-0001`) or `DRAFT`
  2. Second line: customer name (looks up from customers.json; shows "Unknown Customer" if not found)
  3. One line per invoice line: `<qty>x <name> @ <unitPrice> = <lineTotal>`
  4. Last line: `Total: <total>` 
- All monetary amounts use `formatEuros()` for proper formatting (€ symbol, thousand separators, 2 decimals)

Example output:
```
INV-2024-0001
Northwind Studio
8x Design work (hour) @ €85.00 = €680.00
2x Icon set (24 icons) @ €9.80 = €19.60
Total: €699.60
```

Tests cover draft/issued invoices, multiple line items, different customers, VAT-exempt items, and large/small amounts. ✔
